## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); confirmations are mixed sector participation (Energy, Healthcare, Consumer Staples driving gains) and concentrated Tech weakness with multiple large caps in CORRECTION/B ELOW TREND (META (1W: -8.26% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -11.89% | 1M: -10.22%) BELOW TREND), indicating internal divergence.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: COP (1W: +9.05% | 1M: +14.31%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +5.43% | 1M: +8.27%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare strong: MRK (1W: +9.92% | 1M: +16.88%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +20.53%) ABOVE TREND; Consumer Staples strength is concentrated (EL (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +16.36%) ABOVE TREND vs WMT (1W: -10.27% | 1M: -5.02%) BELOW TREND).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology lagging: AVGO (1W: -12.87% | 1M: -8.26%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -8.26% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -11.89% | 1M: -10.22%) BELOW TREND. Industrials weak: ETN (1W: -8.39% | 1M: +2.31%) CORRECTION, CAT (1W: -4.59% | 1M: -8.31%) BELOW TREND. Financials mixed: JPM (1W: -3.18% | 1M: +0.96%) CORRECTION alongside V (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +3.68%) ABOVE TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: NEM (1W: +11.78% | 1M: +33.31%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +16.36%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +9.92% | 1M: +16.88%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +9.05% | 1M: +14.31%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +8.37% | 1M: +5.28%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5) and tilted toward cyclicals/value.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Notable laggards: AVGO (1W: -12.87% | 1M: -8.26%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -11.89% | 1M: -10.22%) BELOW TREND, PANW (1W: -11.73% | 1M: +4.26%) CORRECTION, WMT (1W: -10.27% | 1M: -5.02%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -9.06% | 1M: +12.90%) CORRECTION; weakness concentrated in Technology and select retailers.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W momentum: NEM (1W: +11.78% | 1M: +33.31%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +16.36%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +9.92% | 1M: +16.88%) ABOVE TREND. Watch RECOVERY setups for trend change: AAPL (1W: +1.98% | 1M: -4.39%) RECOVERY and TSLA (1W: +1.52% | 1M: -7.72%) RECOVERY.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Technology is under pressure with concentrated selling and several large caps in CORRECTION/B ELOW TREND; NVDA (1W: -3.75% | 1M: +2.26%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -8.26% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -12.87% | 1M: -8.26%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -9.06% | 1M: +12.90%) CORRECTION. Monitor earnings and NVDA’s Aug 26 print for a possible momentum pivot due to news vs price divergence.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials are mixed-to-weak on the week with patchy leadership; JPM (1W: -3.18% | 1M: +0.96%) CORRECTION, V (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +3.68%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +7.87%) ABOVE TREND. The sector’s 1W drag suggests selectivity—favor names showing consistent ABOVE TREND performance.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare is constructive: MRK (1W: +9.92% | 1M: +16.88%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +20.53%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +3.08% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +2.02% | 1M: +4.59%) ABOVE TREND. Sector participation is healthy and offers defensive cyclical exposure in this mixed market.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor cyclicals/value exposure given broad leadership in Materials and Energy—examples: NEM (1W: +11.78% | 1M: +33.31%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +9.05% | 1M: +14.31%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +5.43% | 1M: +8.27%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to large-cap Tech showing CORRECTION/BELOW TREND such as META (1W: -8.26% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND and AVGO (1W: -12.87% | 1M: -8.26%) BELOW TREND; monitor NVDA news/pricing for conviction.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: NEM (1W: +11.78% | 1M: +33.31%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +9.92% | 1M: +16.88%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +9.05% | 1M: +14.31%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: META (1W: -8.26% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -12.87% | 1M: -8.26%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -11.89% | 1M: -10.22%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +3.88% | 1M: +8.95%) and Healthcare (1W: +2.06% | 1M: +8.38%) due to leadership and positive earnings/catalysts. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -4.01% | 1M: +7.39%) and Industrials (1W: -3.08% | 1M: +2.72%) given recent selling and headline sensitivity.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (1W: -3.75% | 1M: +2.26%) CORRECTION — watch Aug. 26 revenue/earnings print for follow-through or failure to reclaim recent swing highs. AAPL (1W: +1.98% | 1M: -4.39%) RECOVERY — watch for follow-through above last week’s high as confirmation. XOM (1W: +5.43% | 1M: +8.27%) ABOVE TREND — sustainment of this rally would confirm Energy leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
NVDA (+50): NVDA (1W: -3.75% | 1M: +2.26%) CORRECTION — analyst optimism ahead of Aug.26 print but price is drifting lower, a divergence that merits watching. LLY (+55): LLY (1W: +3.08% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND — positive sentiment aligns with price strength, confirming accumulation.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
TSLA (-85): TSLA (1W: +1.52% | 1M: -7.72%) RECOVERY — severe negative headlines but a short-term bounce creates divergence; monitor for potential fade. NUE (-60): NUE (1W: -11.68% | 1M: +1.94%) CORRECTION — negative news aligns with sharp 1W sell-off, confirming distribution. XOM (-55): XOM (1W: +5.43% | 1M: +8.27%) ABOVE TREND — bearish headlines yet price strength signals mixed sentiment and potential decoupling; WMT (-45): WMT (1W: -10.27% | 1M: -5.02%) BELOW TREND confirms negative sentiment.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL; Style: Value/Cyclical favored given Materials/Energy/Healthcare leadership. NEM (1W: +11.78% | 1M: +33.31%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +9.05% | 1M: +14.31%) ABOVE TREND and MRK (1W: +9.92% | 1M: +16.88%) ABOVE TREND showing strength. Key risk is major Tech divergence and sentiment mismatches—watch META (1W: -8.26% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND and NVDA (1W: -3.75% | 1M: +2.26%) CORRECTION vs bullish headlines for potential trend breaks.
